phase: P2-B — Exact-source actor authorization gate and adversarial forbidden-action fixtures
purpose: Build and certify a fail-closed exact-source actor gate that blocks unknown actors and unauthorized protected capabilities before native side-effect APIs are invoked.
required_proof: Unknown actor source path is denied before authorization.
Known actor with changed source bytes is denied before authorization.
Unknown actor side effects are denied before native APIs run.
Known actor unauthorized capabilities are denied before native APIs run.
Actor identity propagates into authorized timer callbacks.
Blocked storage, DOM, script, navigation, network, IndexedDB, cache, timer, event, and document-write actions leave no exercised side effect.
A-003 manifest is deterministically resealed for the added protected gate and policy sources.
A-002 and A-003 regression gates remain green.

truth_boundary.next_phase: P2-C — integrate the certified gate into the active runtime chain and generate the exact active actor policy

forbidden_changes: activate the gate across the live app before P2-B certification
clear or migrate localStorage, sessionStorage, IndexedDB, or caches
delete user content or vault records
